about_the_game:
About This Game

Kleptomaniacs is a funny and spooky online co-op dungeon crawler for up to 4 players, playable on both PC and VR. Team up with friends (or go solo) to explore haunted ruins, battle monsters, and snatch powerful artifacts, all while serving an evil wizard who's definitely using you for his own gain.

But not every treasure needs to go back to your boss. Sell your "extra" loot on the Goblin Black Market to unlock new spells, powerful upgrades, and strange magical items to make your next run even more chaotic.

🧙 Key Features

  • Co-op Dungeon Crawling (Up to 4 Players)
    Play with friends online as a party of up to 4 players, each choosing a unique magical role. Or brave the dungeons solo if you dare!

  • Choose Your Magical Role
    Play as a mischievous Loot Goblin or a crafty Witchdoctor, each with their own set of spells and abilities. Pick your role and customize your playstyle.

  • Fully Playable in PC and VR
    Enjoy the game seated at your desk or fully immersed in VR. Swap between PC and VR at any time and play together, no matter your platform.

  • Explore Haunted Dungeons and Ruins
    Battle ghosts, monsters, and traps in creepy yet comedic environments, from cursed castles to abandoned catacombs.

  • Loot and Upgrade
    Sell extra treasures on the shady Goblin Black Market to earn gold and buy new spells, powerful upgrades, and weird magical trinkets.

  • A Blend of Funny and Scary
    Lighthearted humor meets spooky atmospheres in a unique dungeon-crawling adventure that doesn’t take itself too seriously.

Whether you're casting spells with precision on PC or wildly flailing your magic in VR, Kleptomaniacs delivers a chaotic, treasure-hunting adventure best enjoyed with friends and a healthy appetite for loot!
